comments.body: There's a prereq quest 'The Monogrammed Sash'. It's a drop off a very long respawn time giant named Mok'rash. He spawns at the little island close to booty bay with the giant goblin statue.

https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=618/facing-negolash

Be aware that the next step of this quest is broken. It's listed in their 'general issues' sticky of the Bug Forum, but unfortunately without a 'Future Patch' tag, so I don't personally expect a fix in 1.10
The prereq for this quest is "The Monogrammed Sash"
Is there a prerequisitie for this quest line?
